t: A free app that makes images from text on an iPhone, iPad, or Mac.
steps: Find Draw Things in the App Store.
Check the App Store age rating before school deployment.
Ask IT to approve the install on one iPad or Mac.
Install the app and download a model while online.
Leave Cloud Compute and sign-in off to keep everything on the device.
Test a simple prompt with and without internet.
Set content rules for students before class.
